name: Improve writing
instruction: Improve the writing for clarity, flow, and readability while preserving the original meaning and voice.

name: Shorten
instruction: Shorten the text while preserving its meaning and essential details.

name: Improve clarity
instruction: Rewrite the text to make it clearer and easier to understand without removing important detail.

name: Professional tone
instruction: Rewrite the text in a polished, professional tone while keeping it natural and direct.

name: Friendly tone
instruction: Rewrite the text in a warm, friendly, and approachable tone without sounding artificial.

name: Correct grammar
instruction: Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and obvious usage errors while changing as little else as possible.

name: More formal
instruction: Rewrite the text in a more formal register while preserving its meaning.

name: Expand
instruction: Expand the text with useful detail and smoother transitions, without inventing facts.
